greeting.welcomeDesc: Zero-risk digital transactions backed by AES-256 Vaults and instant AI Arbitration.
greeting.pillar1Desc: Seamless App-to-App dynamic VietQR payments. Funds stay safely locked in escrow smart contracts until inspection completes.
greeting.pillar2Desc: Handover license keys, source code, or confidential data safely. Buyer decrypts only upon confirmed escrow lock.
greeting.pillar3Desc: Client-side video frame extraction and multi-modal AI analysis. Resolves disputes and issues verdicts in minutes.

deals.vietqrInstructions: Open your banking app and scan the dynamic QR code to lock funds into escrow instantly.
